note: Vonk's (Opus 5.5) last fixes, 30 Sept 2026: the two re-rolled photos (R53, R56) and every served line that names a number of degrees. Al's rule (30 Sept, review/photo-batches-ruled.json): lines never name an air temperature — 'it could be a bit cooler or warmer and then it becomes misleading'. Lines that say 'degrees' without a number (e.g. 'Not a degree either.', 'give or take a few degrees', 'worth every degree', 'Minus something this morning') stay. Sea temperatures are pre-marked KEEP (Al passed R42's 'the sea is still 14 degrees'), each with a no-number version he can pick. Photo lines ship en+af only; bank lines (assets/weather-copy.js) ship in five languages, so their zu/xh/st go through the language skills and lang-check. The pool photo (heat/week_3/day/2.webp) stays as it is (Anon found no green mark).

photos.line: Hot already at sunrise: the farmer's day starts at four and ends by ten.
photos.af: Al warm met sonop: die boer se dag begin om vier en is om tien verby.
photos.replaces: Farm stoep with a sprinkler at sunrise; a pleasant morning, not heat
photos.checks: Clean khaki, mopping his brow on the bakkie's tailgate beside the vines; no plate on the bumper; body sits right; real skin; heat reads (low sun, dry ground).

photos.line: Rain at sunrise: this morning's run has become a mud run.
photos.af: Reën met sonop: vanoggend se draf het 'n modderdraf geword.
photos.replaces: Wet jacaranda street in bright sun; reads as after the rain
photos.checks: Rain plainly falling from a grey sky; trail runners, a weekend run on a Saturday; nobody looks at the camera; no text or logos.

lines.en: 7pm and still 30 degrees. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.
lines.af: 19:00 en steeds 30 grade. Die Karoo maak nie foute nie, net stellings.
lines.newEn: 7pm and still this hot. The Karoo doesn't make mistakes, only statements.
lines.newAf: 19:00 en steeds so warm. Die Karoo maak nie foute nie, net stellings.
lines.where: condition bank (5 languages) and a heat-dusk photo line

lines.en: Durban grey is still twenty-four degrees, which is why the promenade never empties.
lines.newEn: Durban grey is still properly warm, which is why the promenade never empties.
lines.newAf: Durban se grys is steeds lekker warm, en daarom raak die promenade nooit leeg nie.
lines.where: photo line (cloudy day, the Durban pier)

lines.en: That mug is steaming because Joburg mornings under cloud start at about four degrees.
lines.newEn: That mug is steaming because Joburg mornings under cloud start properly cold.
lines.newAf: Daardie beker stoom, want Joburg-oggende onder die wolke begin behoorlik koud.

lines.en: First star is out. First ten degrees have also left.
lines.af: Eerste ster is uit. Eerste tien grade is ook uit.
lines.newEn: First star is out. The warmth has clocked out too.
lines.newAf: Eerste ster is uit. Die warmte het ook uitgeklok.
lines.where: condition bank and a cold-clear-night photo line

lines.en: The sun is heading home now, taking the last three degrees with it.
lines.af: Die son gaan nou huis toe. Vat sy laaste drie grade saam.
lines.newEn: The sun is heading home now, taking the last of the warmth with it.
lines.newAf: Die son gaan nou huis toe. Vat die laaste bietjie warmte saam.
lines.where: condition bank and a cold-clear-dusk photo line

lines.en: Outside: 2 degrees. Inside: 9 degrees and a very good fire. SA homes, hey.
lines.af: Buite: 2 grade. Binne: 9 grade en 'n baie goeie vuur. SA huise, nè.
lines.newEn: Outside: freezing. Inside: barely better, and a very good fire. SA homes, hey.
lines.newAf: Buite: yskoud. Binne: skaars beter, en 'n baie goeie vuur. SA huise, nè.

lines.en: The pass is beautiful. The pass is also the opening act for -2°C.
lines.af: Die pas is mooi. Die pas is ook -2°C se voorprogram.
lines.newEn: The pass is beautiful. The pass is also the opening act for a hard frost.
lines.newAf: Die pas is mooi. Die pas is ook 'n harde ryp se voorprogram.

lines.en: The first sip after a 35-degree day should honestly be taxable.
lines.af: Die eerste sluk ná 'n 35-grade dag behoort eerlikwaar belasbaar te wees.
lines.newEn: The first sip after a day this hot should honestly be taxable.
lines.newAf: Die eerste sluk ná só 'n warm dag behoort eerlikwaar belasbaar te wees.

lines.en: It has not dropped below twenty-five in that house since about Tuesday.
lines.newEn: It has not cooled down in that house since about Tuesday.
lines.newAf: Dit het sedert omtrent Dinsdag nie in daardie huis afgekoel nie.
lines.where: photo line (heat night, the open fridge)

lines.en: Blue sky, minus two. The sun's just here to watch.
lines.newEn: Blue sky, proper frost. The sun's just here to watch.
lines.newAf: Blou lug, behoorlike ryp. Die son is net hier om te kyk.

lines.en: The sea is 12 degrees. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.
lines.af: Die see is 12 grade. Teen tienuur gaan dit soos 'n spa voel.
lines.newEn: The sea is freezing. By ten o'clock it's going to feel like a spa.
lines.newAf: Die see is yskoud. Teen tienuur gaan dit soos 'n spa voel.
lines.why: the sea, not the forecast (Al passed R42's '14 degrees')

lines.en: Not a cloud in the sky, and the sea is still 14 degrees.
lines.af: Nie 'n wolk in die lug nie, en die see is steeds 14 grade.
lines.newEn: Not a cloud in the sky, and the sea is still freezing.
lines.newAf: Nie 'n wolk in die lug nie, en die see is steeds yskoud.
lines.why: the sea, not the forecast; Al passed it on 30 Sept (R42)
